generators.carrier: 6x6 complex matrices; U,V maps to U^* V
entrywise squared modulus of a 6x6 complex matrix

relations.statement: Bases given by unitaries U,V are mutually unbiased iff every entry of |U^* V|^2 equals 1/6
relations.hypotheses: U and V are 6x6 unitary matrices

lemmas.statement: No set of four pairwise mutually unbiased bases exists in C^6; together with the known triple this gives maximum three

near_misses.claim: Tensor products of MUB pairs in C^2 and C^3 give 3 MUBs in C^6, so 4 or more follow
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: A product basis from a 2-factor and a 3-factor pair has overlaps 1/2*1/3=1/6, but only min(3,4)-1=2 product MUBs result from the factor counts (2+1=3 in C^2, 3+1=4 in C^3, min=3); this gives 3, not 4
